title: Leek and Cauliflower Patties with Thyme Aioli
subtitle: crumbed and fried
description: Cauliflower and leek patties with parmesan and pine nuts, crumbed and fried until golden and served with a homemade thyme aioli.

steps.text: Boil the cauliflower florets in salted water for about 15 minutes until soft. Drain and cool.

Pulse the cauliflower with the finely chopped white part of the leek, parsley, parmesan, pine nuts, chilli, 2 cloves of garlic, salt, pepper and olive oil in a food processor in 3 to 4 short pulses, until combined but not mushy. Transfer to a bowl, add the flour and 1 egg and mix well. Refrigerate for 15 minutes.

For the aioli, process the egg whites, mustard, 1 tbsp thyme leaves, vinegar, a pinch of salt and 2 cloves of garlic for 2 to 3 minutes until smooth. With the processor running, add the canola oil in a very slow, thin stream until thick and stable like mayonnaise.
Prepare one plate with 2 beaten eggs and another with breadcrumbs. Heat canola oil in a frying pan.
Shape the mixture into patties 4 to 5 cm wide, dip each in egg, coat in breadcrumbs and fry for 3 to 4 minutes until set and golden on both sides. Drain on paper towel.
Serve the patties with grated lemon zest and thyme leaves, and the aioli on the side.
